work: Classroom of the Elite Y1 V7.5

records.claim: Reinterprets the rooftop trauma, recognizes enhanced sense of agency, but still remembers vulnerability and scars.
records.decision_rationale: Personal baseline changed; do not compress to fearless/cured.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Reconstrói o sofrimento do terraço e encontra mais agência; manter também cicatrizes e inseguranças, sem declarar cura.

records.claim: Suppresses jealousy while Satou seeks advice about Kiyotaka; considers steering Satou toward other boys.
records.decision_rationale: Conflict between public friendship, new attachment and self-protection.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Ajuda Satō apesar do ciúme; registrar conflito entre apoio social e temor de perder Kiyotaka, não altruísmo puro.

records.claim: Plans Satou date logistics, accepts double date, balances desire to help with fear of losing Kiyotaka.
records.decision_rationale: Multiple conflicting motives with observed plans, more informative than a flat jealous label.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Aceita preparar o encontro duplo para Satō e administrar aparências; mistura auxílio, interesse próprio e improvisação.

records.claim: Gathers background on Satou through Shinohara at Kiyotaka request despite emotional distress.
records.decision_rationale: Observed cooperation under jealousy; gate who learns Satou details.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Consulta Shinohara a pedido de Kiyotaka mesmo estando emocionalmente abalada; caso de informação social com fonte identificável.

records.claim: Performs fake-couple double date and public interrogations of Kiyotaka, amplifying and undermining Satou.
records.decision_rationale: Competent social performance, strategic ambiguity, no single benevolent intent.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Sustenta o encontro duplo e questiona Kiyotaka em público; desempenho social observado, sem presumir motivo único.

records.claim: Defuses Nagumo grabbing Kiyotaka and publicly minimizes Kiyotaka skill.
records.decision_rationale: Demonstrates rapid social intervention and cover maintenance; not automatic safety against Nagumo.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Intervém com humor quando Nagumo ameaça Kiyotaka; proteger cobertura é ato concreto, não vitória garantida.

records.claim: Overhears Satou rejection, challenges Kiyotaka emotionally, tests explanation and fears replacement.
records.decision_rationale: Critical attachment change with incomplete self-knowledge; no proven established romance.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Ouve a rejeição de Satō, confronta Kiyotaka e teme ser trocada; sinal afetivo forte, mas sem namoro confirmado.

records.claim: Asks about student council, infers unusual visibility, accepts limited knowledge about Manabu/Kiriyama; renews cooperation conditionally.
records.decision_rationale: Scope knowledge and trust state evolves in discrete conversations.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Indaga sobre Manabu, Nagumo e os segredos de Kiyotaka, sem receber todos; separar quem soube o quê.

records.claim: Offers Christmas gift, considers breakup with Hirata, requests assurance of utility/protection, reacts to first-name reciprocity and accepts cold medicine.
records.decision_rationale: Changes protective cover, reciprocity and intimacy without official romantic label.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Reavalia vínculo com Hirata, oferece presente e negocia proteção; mudança relacional concreta, não término já consumado.

records.claim: Meets Sakayanagi alone, questions her Ichinose claims and provokes her merit/status sensitivity.
records.decision_rationale: Conditional manipulation and White Room disclosure boundary, not general defeat of Arisu.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Discute e provoca Arisu quanto a mérito, Ichinose e White Room; manter blefes como blefes, não fatos da escola.

records.claim: Provokes Kiyotaka, threatens to attack Class B, asserts natural-genius theory and pressure on Kamuro.
records.decision_rationale: Active competitive strategy but genuine Ichinose secret remains unverified.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Arisu pressiona Kiyotaka e mira Ichinose, fundamentando sua tese de gênio inato; segredo exato ainda não demonstrado.

records.claim: Interrupts Sakayanagi, challenges suggestion about Ichinose, reveals reaction to secret comparison.
records.decision_rationale: Her responses expose vulnerability yet do not establish precise prior offense.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Reage às insinuações de Arisu sobre Ichinose; seu espanto não certifica qual foi a transgressão anterior.

records.claim: Pursues Kiyotaka, challenges him to secret rematch, chooses restricted storeroom, concedes after short fight.
records.decision_rationale: New combat demonstration with explicit negotiated result and coercive escalation.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Busca revanche, escolhe uma despensa e admite derrota após luta; há novo caso físico, com risco de transgressão.

records.claim: Chooses measured counters in cramped storage, then obtains concession and handles escape via employee Kimura while staging embarrassing-date explanation.
records.decision_rationale: Scene supports practical planning and ethically troubling throat restraint, not infinite martial superiority.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Controla golpes, exige rendição e lida com funcionário após o combate; registrar também contenção perigosa, não excelência moral.

records.claim: Reveals goal of seeing every film screened at school and refuses to leave until Kiyotaka does.
records.decision_rationale: Noncompetitive durable personal goal and trait of commitment distinct from class A.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Ibuki pretende assistir a todos os filmes exibidos; um objetivo extracurricular independente do desempenho acadêmico.

records.claim: Hides with Kiyotaka from Ishizaki, challenges leader narrative and asks about 800 million in private points.
records.decision_rationale: Demonstrates loyal opposition and financial interpretation, not confirmed loyalty to Kiyotaka.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Evita exposição com Kiyotaka e questiona o plano de Ryūen; independência e lealdade crítica coexistem.

records.claim: Intervenes for Shinohara in senior dispute, downplays it, then accepts Christmas Eve dinner invitation.
records.decision_rationale: Demonstrated spontaneous defense and potential relational change, not certified dating.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Defende Shinohara da intimidação de veteranos, embora use comentários grosseiros; depois aceita jantar com ela.

records.claim: Struggles with assertive upperclassman, recognizes Ike help, invites him to dinner.
records.decision_rationale: Social vulnerability then reciprocity; useful non-main romance seed.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Reconhece a ajuda de Ike e o convida; mudança recíproca incipiente, não anúncio de casal.

records.claim: Organizes Christmas single-students gathering, infers Satou date, arranges protection for Airi feelings.
records.decision_rationale: Social care, group cohesion, peer romance mediation.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Organiza encontro festivo e protege Airi do constrangimento; liderança afetiva da rede de amigos.

records.claim: Visits Kiyotaka after outing with Haruka to give gloves, with shy but deliberate approach.
records.decision_rationale: Self-initiated extracurricular social action and a concrete caring gift.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Leva luvas a Kiyotaka em iniciativa própria; gesto social relevante para a evolução de Airi.

records.claim: Acknowledges Airi affection but treats her as still learning friendship and seeks appropriate response to her present.
records.decision_rationale: Shows interpersonal learning without accepting romantic intimacy.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Reconhece a atração de Airi e pondera seu amadurecimento; não corresponde romanticamente nem despreza o gesto.

records.claim: Recontacts Ryuen, exposes fear and liability factors, negotiates verbal conditional cooperation including Kushida issue.
records.decision_rationale: Strategy changes from physical defeat to conditional political diplomacy, not a permanent alliance.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Reabre diálogo com Ryūen após vencê-lo e propõe cooperação específica; não existe aliança permanente.

records.claim: Discusses his fear, 800 million possibilities, asks compensation and stages future C(D) leadership by Kaneda/Hiyori.
records.decision_rationale: Adaptation and self-preservation after defeat; goals and tactics both conditional.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Negocia interesses, discute sua estratégia de pontos e prepara liderança indireta; derrota não elimina agência.

records.claim: Proposes obtaining very large recurring point streams from all school grades as speculative finance scheme.
records.decision_rationale: Important ability to generate extreme strategy; do not treat extortion as actual school-legal method.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Formula captação hipotética de pontos dos demais alunos; conservar como estratégia especulativa, não receita comprovada.

records.claim: Arrives at secret meeting and recruits Kiyotaka against Nagumo; supplies council roster and makes conditional cooperation promise.
records.decision_rationale: Important governance/information brokerage without universal power.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Intermedeia a rede anti-Nagumo e fornece dados de integrantes do conselho; autoridade e limites do ex-presidente.

records.claim: Tests Manabu with snow feint and jab; Manabu blocks and de-escalates.
records.decision_rationale: Distinct minor physical demonstration; not Ryuen-Manabu full duel.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Ryūen testa Manabu com ataque breve, que é bloqueado; não transformar em duelo completo ou ranking universal.

records.claim: Accepts introduction to second-year Nagumo opposition despite wishing to remain anonymous; assesses reputational exposure.
records.decision_rationale: Concrete choice changes who learns about him and who can use him.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Aceita ser apresentado à oposição de Nagumo e assume risco reputacional; expansão voluntária da visibilidade.

records.claim: Meets Kushida publicly, resists Kiyotaka council request, calls brother after contact through Tachibana, still refuses council membership.
records.decision_rationale: Relationship repair and autonomy; not accepted student-council appointment.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Conversa com Kushida e fala com Manabu, mas recusa entrar no conselho; iniciativa social e autonomia preservadas.

records.claim: Appears amicably with Suzune, already has Tachibana phone information and helps contact Manabu.
records.decision_rationale: Social network demonstrated, underlying hostility not thereby resolved.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Mobiliza contato de Tachibana e mostra laços com veteranos; aparente gentileza não resolve sua rivalidade com Suzune.

records.claim: Pursues first date, rehearses double-date support, confesses directly and accepts rejection with tears while asking to remain friends.
records.decision_rationale: Courage and emotional response, not manipulation or a current couple.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Prepara encontro amoroso e se declara, aceitando rejeição com sofrimento; atitude corajosa e contextual.

records.claim: Accepts Christmas date, socializes with mixed group, refuses Satou candidly due to lack of reciprocated love and current risk burden.
records.decision_rationale: First social/romantic event and refusal, not declaration of incapacity to love.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Participa de seu primeiro encontro e recusa Satō honestamente; ausência atual de amor não é incapacidade permanente.

records.claim: Handles double date and Nagumo encounter, describes prioritizing others happiness and fear of class disintegration.
records.decision_rationale: Social de-escalation, hidden fragility and relationship disinterest in his own POV.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Ajuda a administrar o encontro e conversa sobre seus valores; sociabilidade e fragilidade diante da desunião.

records.claim: Interrupts Christmas double date, grips Kiyotaka arm and uses mock invitation/online-game special-exam provocation.
records.decision_rationale: An active targeted social threat; online-game hypothetical not approved ExamSpec.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Pressiona fisicamente Kiyotaka no shopping e debocha diante dos amigos; ameaça social real, sem exame aprovado.

records.claim: Hirata explains club preference and does not want student council post.
records.decision_rationale: Retain as Hirata-specific sport/social context only; label is corrected in primary actor field before promotion.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Prefere continuar no futebol a aceitar eventual atuação no conselho; interesse extracurricular independente.

records.claim: Kiyotaka brings Kei as apparent partner to meeting with Kiriyama, enabling plausible couple cover; assesses each side’s incentives.
records.decision_rationale: Crucial visibility and knowledge-sharing choices, not established romantic couple.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Usa Kei como acompanhante e disfarce ao encontrar Kiriyama; parceria operacional não certifica romance formal.

records.claim: Discloses opposition to Nagumo, remains vice president for access, proposes cautious anonymous communications.
records.decision_rationale: New first-hand political actor case; allegations need attribution to Kiriyama.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Integra o conselho enquanto resiste a Nagumo e propõe mensagens anônimas; motivação altruísta ainda é relato dele.

records.claim: Admits he intentionally shifted Kei from Hirata protection to dependence on him, reciprocates first-name address and reveals previously purchased medicine.
records.decision_rationale: Mixed protection and control with ambiguous affect, not proven mutual love.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Explica ter aumentado a dependência de Kei, mas também revela preocupação e reciprocidade; não reduzir a gesto romântico puro.

records.claim: Says she feels stronger after V7, but retains body scar insecurity and past memories.
records.decision_rationale: Stage snapshot rather than an invented categorical cure.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Diz sentir força nova sem apagar medos e cicatrizes; contexto temporal para estados contraditórios.

records.claim: Considers abandoning publicly fake relationship with Hirata and romantic jealousy of Satou.
records.decision_rationale: Intent not completed breakup at this scene.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Cogita desfazer relacionamento falso e percebe ciúme; intenção ainda reversível.

records.claim: Fears she is a replaceable intelligence asset and Kiyotaka no longer needs her.
records.decision_rationale: Private attachment vulnerability, not observed objective diminished competence.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Teme ser substituída como parceira útil; sentimento privado, não avaliação objetiva da competência dela.

records.claim: Requests first-name Kiyotaka-Kei form and reassesses Hirata cover, increasing reciprocal exclusivity.
records.decision_rationale: New relationship evidence does not confirm boyfriend/girlfriend status.
records.decision_explanation_pt: A troca de nomes próprios e a reflexão sobre Hirata sugerem aproximação, não namoro confirmado.

records.claim: Reflects on unfamiliarity with ordinary romance, inability to show smile, uncertainty and potential future closeness with Kei.
records.decision_rationale: Changing model of interpersonal goals not a fixed incapacity to love.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Reflete sobre amor, sorriso e normalidade; aprendizado possível, não personalidade congelada.

records.claim: Visibility expands: Arisu knows White Room; Ryuen/roof group know X; Nagumo sees relay; Kiriyama gains identity; Satou sees runner.
records.decision_rationale: Maintain separate knowledge sets, no school-wide identity broadcast.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Conhecimento se distribui entre Arisu, grupo do terraço, Nagumo, Kiriyama e Satō; não há publicidade universal de X.

records.claim: His decision to preserve Kei involves coercive utility reasoning alongside genuine gestures and conditional warmth.
records.decision_rationale: Dual motive, not moral redemption or objectively romantically in love.
records.decision_explanation_pt: A avaliação instrumental sobre Kei coexiste com cuidado observável; registrar fonte íntima e atos externos separadamente.

records.claim: Attraction dates from sports festival, confesses on December 25, remains open to friendship after rejection.
records.decision_rationale: Romantic state dynamic independent from annual class rank.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Satō se encanta após a corrida, declara-se e aceita continuar amiga; evolução afetiva sem nova meta escolar.

records.claim: Persistence, film hobby, resentment, own tactical judgment and admission of defeat coexist.
records.decision_rationale: Do not equate defeat with obedience or conversion to Kiyotaka.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Hobby de cinema, orgulho e ressentimento de Ibuki coexistem com aceitação de derrota.

records.claim: Retreats from direct command but keeps entrepreneurship/ambition and capacity to negotiate.
records.decision_rationale: Defeat changes behavior, not total removal from class history.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Ryūen reduz o comando direto sem perder planejamento ou autonomia; mudança de meio, não apagamento de identidade.

records.claim: Declines Sudou Christmas invitation and Kiyotaka student-council recommendation; initiates tentative contact with Kushida.
records.decision_rationale: Independent priorities vs romance, fraternal acceptance not automatic membership.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Suzune recusa Sudō e a vaga no conselho, mas tenta conviver com Kushida; decisões distintas.

records.claim: Fake romantic partnership still public, no desire for other dating, soccer remains central.
records.decision_rationale: His noninterest and vulnerability not necessarily permanent.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Hirata sustenta romance público fictício, valoriza futebol e declara pouco interesse próprio em namoro.

records.claim: Haruka’s friendship supports growth; first gift action demonstrates initiative outside classroom.
records.decision_rationale: Small meaningful developmental step not merely gift metadata.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Amizade com Haruka permite a Airi agir além da antiga retração; gesto pequeno, mudança demonstrada.

records.claim: Preserves autonomy of friend group while protecting Airi from dating news.
records.decision_rationale: Group support, no guarantee Airi never learns.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Haruka protege Airi e flexibiliza encontro do grupo; não controlar automaticamente a futura descoberta do romance.

records.claim: Assistance and invitation foreshadow possible romance without public couple announcement.
records.decision_rationale: Do not skip as decorative shopping encounter.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Ike e Shinohara passam da hostilidade cotidiana à reciprocidade, sem declaração oficial de namoro.

records.claim: V7.5 introduces second-year vice president Kiriyama, secretaries Mizowaki and Tonokawa, faction and opposition.
records.decision_rationale: Organizational relation evidence, source-scoped roster.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Kiriyama, Mizowaki e Tonokawa aparecem na estrutura; registrar funções e facções com cronologia.

records.claim: Manabu says council participates in school disciplinary proceedings and partly in designing special exams (island test example).
records.decision_rationale: Affects institutional jurisdiction; do not infer unlimited independent rulemaking.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Manabu relata participação disciplinar e elaboração parcial de exames pelo conselho; autoridade não é ilimitada.

records.claim: Manabu reports 17 second-year expulsions and claims Nagumo involved in more than half based on exit interviews.
records.decision_rationale: Report figure with attributed source; not independently audited ledger.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Manabu reporta 17 expulsões e participação de Nagumo em mais da metade; dado atribuído, sem auditoria dos 17 casos.

records.claim: Kiriyama claims Nagumo has most second years under control and offers class-A promotion chances; Kiriyama remains inside council to observe.
records.decision_rationale: Faction dynamics and incentives, some future policies unverifiable.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Kiriyama relata hegemonia de Nagumo e proposta de mobilidade; promessas não equivalem a regras efetivadas.

records.claim: Private-point class transfer reference confirms 20 million per individual, 800 million for forty; V7 earlier 2m quote remains discrepancy.
records.decision_rationale: Supports known rule, not evidence of discounts or actual cohort movement.
records.decision_explanation_pt: V7.5 volta a citar 20 milhões por aluno e 800 milhões por turma; confrontar com fala divergente do V7, sem apagar fonte.

records.claim: Public mall staff-only storage access, trapping door, school-related discipline uncertainty and staff discretion.
records.decision_rationale: Specific place security episode only; not normative loophole for any student.
records.decision_explanation_pt: A entrada na despensa e reação do funcionário exemplificam riscos locais; não são um manual normativo de segurança.

records.claim: Winter holiday Dec 23-25: public mall, cinema, cafés, dorms, school building available with constraints; students retain off-class social lives.
records.decision_rationale: Simulation environment/schedule context, not a new special exam.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Férias permitem shopping, cinema, cafés e convivência; registrar disponibilidade contextual, não um exame.

records.claim: Arisu knows White Room past; Kiyotaka contrasts regimented childhood with inability to experience normal dating.
records.decision_rationale: Character memory and external knowledge gate, no verified new WR training curriculum.
records.decision_explanation_pt: White Room explica limitação afetiva de Kiyotaka e é conhecida por Arisu; não inventar novo currículo.

records.claim: Legendary confession tree appears in school bulletin-board forum with alleged sunset success chance.
records.decision_rationale: Urban legend exists as rumor; percentage not institutional guarantee.
records.decision_explanation_pt: A árvore romântica aparece em fórum, mas a chance de 99% é superstição, não regra escolar.

records.claim: Relay performance generates Satou attraction and Nagumo/Kiriyama interest in Kiyotaka.
records.decision_rationale: Important retrospective reputational effect, not changed race score.
records.decision_explanation_pt: A corrida anterior explica interesse de Satō e atenção dos veteranos; efeito reputacional, sem recalcular resultado.

records.claim: Manabu describes prior island exam as at least partly based on student council proposal.
records.decision_rationale: Institutional design provenance, not newly codified island scoring rule.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Manabu atribui parte da criação da prova da ilha ao conselho; retrospectiva institucional, sem inventar pontuação.

records.claim: Ryuen/Kei/Kiyotaka discuss previous secrets and school tactics from cruise in postfacto conversations.
records.decision_rationale: Retrospective contextual links, not new VIP formula or exam outcome.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Diálogos resgatam segredos antigos do cruzeiro; contexto posterior, sem alterar VIPs nem regras.

records.claim: Kiriyama forecasts January special exam with interactions among 1st/2nd and sometimes 3rd years, and says years vary.
records.decision_rationale: Future unnamed exam warning; no rules, teams or dates to instantiate.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Kiriyama prevê prova entre séries em janeiro, sem formato definitivo; manter como alerta de exame futuro.

records.claim: Nagumo suggests online-game-based special exam during hostile chat.
records.decision_rationale: Provocation/hypothesis, not enacted rule or authorized ExamSpec.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Nagumo menciona jogo online como provocação; não há autorização para criar um ExamSpec.

records.claim: Karuizawa and Satou speculate about winter-break exams; nothing announced.
records.decision_rationale: Holiday not an examination; no fictitious pack should be created.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Alunos especulam sobre exame nas férias, mas o volume não mostra prova; rejeitar existência inventada.

records.claim: Cinema projector malfunction halts the show.
records.decision_rationale: Atmospheric obstacle, keep only as context for Ibuki confrontation; not standalone meaningful skill demonstration.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Defeito no cinema aproxima Ibuki e Kiyotaka, mas, por si só, não demonstra habilidade de ninguém.

records.claim: Buys two types of cold medicine.
records.decision_rationale: Purchase alone is trivia; KEEP contextual link to delayed welfare concern/Kei trust change.
records.decision_explanation_pt: A compra de remédios isolada é detalhe; sua finalidade e a reação de Kei é que justificam caso afetivo.

records.claim: Leaves snow on his head and does not brush it off.
records.decision_rationale: Humorous mannerism rather than robust permanent psychological trait.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Cabeça coberta de neve é traço cômico local, insuficiente para atributo permanente.

records.claim: Forum claims 99 percent success for confessions at a tree.
records.decision_rationale: Do not import fabricated probability into engine; store as school rumor.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Boato de sucesso na árvore não é probabilidade oficial do sistema.

records.primary_actor_or_organization: Generic café and movie date venues
records.claim: Characters spend time in mall and movie theater.
records.decision_rationale: Keep geography/environment metadata; cannot classify every meal as a separate competence case.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Rotinas de cafeteria e cinema são ambientais; não criar um feito para cada compra, prato ou caminhada.

records.claim: Jokes about singles and makes rude remarks to Ike.
records.decision_rationale: Retain social-group scene context, insufficient change in preference or repeatable decision pattern.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Provocações de Yamauchi são pano de fundo para Ike, não uma transição suficientemente demonstrada.

records.claim: Claims he resists Nagumo only for future students welfare.
records.decision_rationale: Attribution to his self-report; no certainty of pure motive.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Kiriyama alega altruísmo e Kiyotaka desconfia; manter motivo aberto e atribuído.

records.claim: Suggests willingness to expel Kushida at expense of future class points.
records.decision_rationale: A serious conditional proposal, not completed expulsion or irrevocable runtime objective.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Proposta para expulsar Kushida não é expulsão ocorrida nem objetivo futuro obrigatório.

records.claim: Mutual first names and narration of potential future relationship.
records.decision_rationale: Strong interpersonal signals but no current confession or officially declared romance.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Chamar Kei pelo primeiro nome e imaginar futuro juntos não torna os dois namorados naquele momento.

records.claim: Hypothesizes 48m-100m monthly extraction across school and 800m potential.
records.decision_rationale: Numbers are thought experiment, not observed income stream or permitted exploit.
records.decision_explanation_pt: Ryūen calcula somas elevadas de captação; isso não prova pontos acumulados nem viabilidade institucional.
